summary: This note describes the film Lady Godiva Rides Again and is notable for featuring actresses who later became famous. Diana Dors appears as a beauty queen and was later marketed as the film's star. Joan Collins makes her film debut as an uncredited beauty contestant, and Ruth Ellis, the last woman executed in England, appears as an uncredited beauty queen.
one_line: Note on the film Lady Godiva Rides Again, known for early uncredited or minor appearances by future stars Diana Dors, Joan Collins and Ruth Ellis.
key_facts: Lady Godiva Rides Again is a film that is most notable for featuring actresses who were later to become famous.

Joan Collins appears as an uncredited beauty contestant in Lady Godiva Rides Again.
Ruth Ellis appears in Lady Godiva Rides Again as an uncredited beauty queen.
Ruth Ellis is described in the note as the last woman to be executed in England.
Ruth Ellis was four months pregnant at the time she appeared in the film.
Ruth Ellis had dyed her hair black for her role in the film.
Ruth Ellis had styled her hair into a bob for her role in the film.
The note does not give a release date, director or cast beyond the three named actresses.
